# ankra_security_dispositions (Data Source)

Lists the organisation's vulnerability disposition policies (acknowledgements and accepted risks), the counterpart of `ankra security dispositions list`. Revoked policies are included unless `statuses` leaves them out.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_security_dispositions" "accepted_risks" {
  statuses    = ["active", "expiring"]
  disposition = "accepted_risk"
}

output "accepted_risk_reasons" {
  value = { for policy in data.ankra_security_dispositions.accepted_risks.dispositions : policy.id => policy.reason }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `disposition` (String) Only `acknowledged` or only `accepted_risk` policies.
- `statuses` (List of String) Only policies in one of these statuses: `active`, `expiring`, `fix_available`, `mitigated`, `unmatched`, `expired` or `revoked`.

### Read-Only

- `dispositions` (Attributes List) Disposition policies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dispositions))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.

<a id="nestedatt--dispositions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dispositions`

Read-Only:

- `addon_slug` (String) Add-on the selector pins, if any.
- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster the selector pins, if any.
- `created_at` (String) When the policy was made (RFC 3339).
- `created_by` (String) Who made the policy.
- `cve_id` (String) CVE the selector pins, if any.
- `disposition` (String) `acknowledged` or `accepted_risk`.
- `expire_when_fix_available` (Boolean) Whether the policy ends once a fix is available.
- `expires_at` (String) Review deadline (RFC 3339); null for none.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the policy.
- `match_health` (String) How well the selector still matches.
- `matched_occurrence_count` (Number) Occurrences the policy matches.
- `package_name` (String) Package the selector pins, if any.
- `reason` (String) Why the policy was made.
- `revoked_at` (String) When the policy was revoked; null while it is not.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status.
- `workload_name` (String) Workload the selector pins, if any.
- `workload_namespace` (String) Workload namespace the selector pins, if any.
